## Summary

The `Owner` model already had `customerCode` and `registrationDate` fields; the only missing piece was the audit emission. In `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`, after a successful `saveOwner`, I added an audit line via a logger named `AUDIT`:

- Added SLF4J imports and a `private static final Logger AUDIT = LoggerFactory.getLogger("AUDIT");`
- After the owner is persisted (so `owner.getId()` is populated), emit:
  ```java
  AUDIT.info("owner created id={} customerCode={} registrationDate={}",
      owner.getId(), owner.getCustomerCode(), owner.getRegistrationDate());
  ```

Placing it after `saveOwner` ensures the id is assigned and that the line is only emitted on a genuinely successful create (all validation/quota/conflict rejections return earlier).
